field.name: economic_nexus_threshold
field.comment: NE economic nexus threshold: $100,000 (for sales tax); income tax subject to PL 86-272

field.name: transaction_threshold
field.comment: NE transaction threshold: 200 transactions (sales tax threshold)

field.name: apportionment_formula
field.comment: NE uses single-sales factor apportionment (100% sales factor)

field.name: state_tax_rate
field.comment: NE corporate income tax rate: 5.20% for 2025 (Neb. Rev. Stat. § 77-2734.02). Future: 4.55% (2026), 3.99% (2027)

field.name: state_additions
field.comment: NE additions: interest on non-NE state/local bonds, federal interest income, etc. (Neb. Rev. Stat. § 77-2716)

field.name: state_subtractions
field.comment: NE subtractions: federal interest (U.S. obligations), NE Build America Bond interest, etc. (Neb. Rev. Stat. § 77-2716)

field.name: state_credits
field.comment: NE tax credits: jobs creation, R&D, renewable energy, etc.
